subject.title: fix(slack): time out stalled external file uploads

question: Must this PR demonstrate the final head's new Enterprise completion-client routing in a real controlled run before merge, or are the earlier transport run plus final-head integration tests and upstream SDK inspection sufficient?
rationale: The unproven delta controls a commit-capable one-shot API call and workspace routing; automation can assess the code but cannot safely decide the repository's required live-proof bar for that changed production path.

options.title: Require final-head Enterprise proof
options.body: Capture redacted output on head 5ef0791 showing one upload completion request through the expected team and API origin, with no retry.

options.title: Accept combined evidence
options.body: Treat the earlier transport run, final-head focused tests, green checks, and pinned upstream SDK contract as sufficient without another live run.

recommendation.title: Require final-head Enterprise proof
recommendation.body: Capture redacted output on head 5ef0791 showing one upload completion request through the expected team and API origin, with no retry.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the post-proof Enterprise refactor, supplied the existing proof, and are the live assignee best positioned to judge or close the remaining evidence gap.
